item.title: WRE News: Miami-Fort Lauderdale Rents Drop Again, Extending 29-Month Decline
item.description: Miami, FL - March 2, 2026 - The latest report from Realtor.com shows January 2026 marked the 29th consecutive month of year-over-year rent decreases for 0–2 bedroom units nationwide, with Miami-Fort Lauderdale-West Palm Beach following suit. In South Florida, the median asking rent dropped to $2,236 — a 3.7% annual decline — as vacancy rates fell slightly to 8.1% in 2025 but remained well above the 7% threshold that signals a renter-friendly market.
